Simple, reliable bookkeeping for mess businesses

Desi Meals is a simple and reliable mess management and accounting application designed to help food businesses manage customers, meal charges, payments, expenses, and financial reports in one convenient place. Built for mess services, hostels, tiffin providers, and monthly meal businesses — usable with basic smartphone knowledge.

19 MB debug APK ✓ builds 9/9 unit tests pass 32 screens implemented

Modules

📊 Dashboard

Received, paid-out, outstanding, expenses, advance, today/month figures, pending dues, quick actions, Today/Week/Month/Year filter.

👥 Customers

Profiles, meal plans, status, search by name/ID/mobile, monthly billing, PDF statements, overdue reminders.

🧾 Debit / Credit ledger

Per-customer running balance. Debit increases due, credit reduces it. Advance = negative. Duplicate-payment guard.

🍽️ Meals & invoices

Daily present/absent, extra meals, monthly bill generation with duplicate-period protection.

🛒 Expenses

16 categories + custom, paid/unpaid tracking, vendor search, top-category insights.

💰 Cashbook & bank

Cash/bank accounts, IN/OUT entries, transfers excluded from income/expense, daily closing.

🏭 Suppliers

Bills vs. payments tracked separately. Outstanding = opening + billed − paid. No double-counting.

📈 Reports

P&L, income, expenses, receivables, payables, cash flow, meals, overdue — date-filtered with PDF/Excel/CSV export.

Accounting accuracy

customer balance = opening + debits − credits  •  profit = recognized income − expenses

Meal charges are recognized income; customer payments reduce receivables and never create duplicate income. Transfers, owner capital, and withdrawals are classified separately. Supplier bills are liabilities until paid.
